programme_facts.value: Goethe University accompanies international students with comprehensive counseling and service offers throughout their academic journey from application to graduation.
The PBS offers support and a listening ear for personal concerns. Every semester, the PBS provides online lectures and workshops on topics such as self-reflection, resilience, and stress management.

The PSB supports students with personal and study-related challenges, such as anxiety, loneliness, relationship stress, or learning blocks. In addition to individual and couples counseling, there are also group offers.
In addition to a diverse sports program, university sports also offers courses and videos on stress management and self-assertion, as well as events to get active and make new contacts.
Goethe University promotes an equitable and critically discriminatory environment and stands for equality, diversity, and inclusion.
Counseling in cases of discrimination as well as measures for prevention and reduction of discrimination.
